note: Diagram Drill seeds (pedagogy-spec §2 Tier 1). `svgInline` is a hand-drawn, self-contained SVG in a STRICT subset — only svg/g/path/line/rect/circle/ellipse/polyline/polygon/text/tspan, geometry and presentation attributes only, no script, no event handlers, no href/xlink, no url() and no data: references; colours come from currentColor and the design tokens var(--accent) / var(--surface-muted), never a raw hex. Because it is first-party static content in a validated subset, mount it with DOMParser("image/svg+xml") + importNode (or an with a blob), never innerHTML. The figure deliberately DOES NOT print the labels: every labellable feature is a numbered target circle, and parts[] gives {id, label, x, y} with x and y in viewBox coordinates so the drill can position an input over each target and score per part.

Is it a non-zero digit? If yes it always counts
Leading zeros: never significant (0.00520 has three)
